name: golden_chase
js: a.drive.cam.orbitHold = true; a.drive.sim.input.brake = 1; a.drive.cam.yawOff = 2.2; a.drive.cam.pitchOff = 0.18; a.drive.cam.distance = 9;

name: golden_sun
js: const s = a.drive.sim, sd = window.__THREE ? null : null; const sun = a.terrain.uniforms.uSunDir ? a.terrain.uniforms.uSunDir.value : null; const d = sun || {x: -0.8, z: 0.3}; a.drive.cam.yawOff = Math.atan2(d.x, d.z) - Math.atan2(s.fwd.x, s.fwd.z); a.drive.cam.pitchOff = 0.05; a.drive.cam.distance = 10;
